mentions.name: jeremymaslanko.com personal blog
mentions.description: A personal blog the author created a couple of years ago and now uses as a way to learn, enjoying the writing process, with a deliberately simple UI and nothing groundbreaking.
mentions.source_excerpt: My blog. I created it a couple years ago but didn't really know what to do with it. Have started to use it as a way to learn and have enjoyed writing more than I thought I would. Nothing crazy with UI and I am not talking about anything groundbreaking, but it's been fun!
